name: evalclimb
description: Optimize an app's decision prompt from reviewed labeled examples with EvalClimb and integrate the generated decide() caller.

interface.shortDescription: Optimize decision prompts from labeled examples
interface.longDescription: Optimize an app's decision prompt against reviewed labeled examples over text, images or PDFs, compare held-out scores and integrate the generated decide() caller. No sign-in; every upload and result is public, so your agent asks before uploading and again before publishing a run.
defaultPrompt: Optimize my app's decision prompt with EvalClimb.
Find a public EvalClimb run to reuse.
Replace my decision call with EvalClimb's generated decide().
